attributes.residual: REFUTES THE WORK ORDER'S PREMISE, which is the deliverable here. The order said CL's run-41 source work 'removed the exact words WZ's refusal cited' and asked for the composed synthesis to be re-run. It was: the words WZ cited are indeed gone and the function is down to five words, but what remains is a class the postprocessor is fail-closed against by construction, not a smaller version of the old residual. Re-running the synthesis was the right instruction and it produced a RECLASSIFICATION rather than a rule. Note also, for whoever maintains wf_word_diff: its CLASS line says `RECOLOR - streams index-aligned, only register fields differ` for this function, which is false. The heading is derived from MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE = 0 and cannot see an immediate difference, so a lane that trusts the heading over the word list will queue a frame-size residual as a recolor. That is a real trap and it is one line to fix.

Our frame is 0x30 bytes where the target's is 0x28: an 8-byte SURPLUS on our side, with the saved-register block and every frame reference shifted by the same 8.
